Fishio received 2000 likes initially. Three weeks later, the number of likes was 70 times as many as the initial number of likes, so $ 70 \times 2000 = 140000 $ likes. 

She received 20000 more new likes recently. 

Total likes = Initial likes + Recent likes = $ 2000 + 20000 = 22000 $.

FINAL_ANSWER: 22000
